# PR & Earned Media

`pr-and-earned-media` · v1.0.0 · Execute · Content & Copy
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/pr-and-earned-media/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Is this story worth pitching to journalists yet, and are the pitch and press materials ready?

**Inputs:** What the coverage is for, the story idea and the evidence behind it, the audience you want to reach, and any customer results you have permission to share

**Output:** A newsworthiness score with the failed checks named, a materials-readiness list, a short targeted outlet list, a pitch draft under 200 words, and a tracking sheet structure

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill pr-and-earned-media`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/pr-and-earned-media/resources/newsworthiness.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/pr-and-earned-media/resources/newsworthiness.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It is a rubric, not a prediction. No score makes coverage likely, and it cannot know an editor's calendar.
- The company-removed and forward tests and the evidence checks are yes/no answers you give. The score is only as honest as those answers.
- It counts named outlets but cannot check they exist or cover the beat. Non-customer stories pass the permission check automatically.
- Pass {check, input}; with no input you get a labelled demo. An unknown check or top-level field stops the run, but fields inside input that it doesn't know are ignored, so use the names in the header.

**Review before acting:** The founder checks every figure in the story against its written method and confirms written customer permission before the first pitch. Whoever sends it checks each outlet and reporter is real and covers this beat.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/pr-and-earned-media](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/pr-and-earned-media)
